entry.title: The Oracle of Gotham
entry.summary:
Author: Ava_Mae

Rating: General AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 2,829Chapters: 1/1Kudos: 80

Summary: You glanced down at the phone in your hand, then cautiously put it to your ear. "...hello?"  "Hello." You were greeted by a computer automated voice, throwing you off for a brief second. "Can I presume I'm talking to Hood's nurse friend?" "Uh… yeah?" A little bit stunned, you instinctively gave your name to the other person on the line. Was that stupid? Too late now. "Nightwing said-- are you really Oracle?" "That I am." The computer voice managed to sound the tiniest bit proud of that fact, despite the tonelessness to the voice. "Is Nightwing still there?" You glanced up at the rooftop again, then winced as the sound of a gunshot rang out. "Uh… Jay's chasing him across a rooftop right now." You frowned. "Jay wouldn't actually hurt him, would he? Because I definitely heard a gunshot, but I can also hear Nightwing laughing even from here." "Hood has rubber bullets in his guns. Nightwing might get a pretty nasty bruise, but he should be fine." Oracle paused for a beat. "He should have rubber bullets, at least. One moment." The line went completely silent for a few seconds before Oracle spoke again. "He has rubber bullets. They'll both be fine."
